newsitem.title: ICELAND: SOCCER-ICELAND/LITHUANIA LIMP TO GOALLESS DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ICELAND/LITHUANIA LIMP TO GOALLESS DRAW.

text.p: Iceland and Lithuania fumbled their way to an uneventul, goalless draw in their World Cup European zone group eight qualifying round at Reykjavik's Laugardalur Stadium on Wednesday.
Lithuania was clearly the more dangerous side in the first half but repeated failed to capitalise on a whole array of mistakes by the Icelandic defence.

Hesitation cost Lithuania's Edjaras Jankauskas an early goal when he allowed Icelandic keeper Kristjan Finnbogason to smother the ball at his feet in the 16th minute. He sent the ball wide of an almost open goal three minutes later.
In the second half Iceland came on much stronger with Sigurdur Jonsson, who plays with Orebro in Sweden, sending the ball over the bar twice in a minute.

Iceland's best chance was in the 54th minute when Bjarki Gunlaugsson, of Mannheim in Germany, alone and unchallenged in the penalty area, fumbled the ball into Lithuania keeper Gintaras Stauche's receptive arms.
Twice in the second half Lithuania failed to shoot when one-on-one with the Icelandic goalkeeper.
Jankauskas, who plays for Torpedo-Luzhniki of Russia, waited too long before an open goal in the 62nd minute.
Four minutes from the whistle Finnbogason literally chased a lone Irnantas Stumbrys off the pitch to howls of relieved laughter from the stands.

Iceland - Kristjan Finnbogason, Sigurdur Jonsson, Gudni Bergsson, Larus Orri Sigurdsson, Eyjolfur Sverrisson, Runar Kristinsson, Thordur Gudjonsson (yellwo card in 44th minute, replaced 82nd minute by Rikjargur Dadason), Sigursteinn Gislason (replaced 79th minute by Arnar Gertarsson), Arnor Gudjohnsen, Arnar Gunnlaugsson (replaced 72nd minute by Helgi Sigurdsson), Bjarki Gunnlaugsson.

Lithuania - Gintaras Stauche, Tomas Ziukus (yellow card in 30th minute), Andrejus Tereskinas, Giedrius Zutautas, Raimondas Vainoras, Irnantas Stumbrys, Raimondas Zutautas (42nd minute yellow card), Vaidotas Slekys, Aidas Treiksaitis, Aurelijus Skarabalius, Edjaras Jankauskas.
